name: Aile Strike Gundam
summary: Cosmic Era / Mobile Suit Gundam SEED
description: Archive lineage note: Aile Strike Gundam is the GAT-X105 Strike Gundam equipped with the AQM/E-X01 Aile Striker pack. In the Strike Family view, this record represents the base Strike Gundam at family order 1; later Strike-derived machines branch from it.
